blocks.text: This release tightens how admin sign-in works. Sessions are now granted only after a second factor, they stay valid while you keep working instead of expiring mid-afternoon, and the old token endpoint is gone. Nothing to migrate: sign in again and continue as usual.

items: Second factor at sign-in — org admins confirm a code before any session cookie is set (Authentication).
Sessions that slide forward — an active session renews its cookie expiry on each request instead of dying at a fixed time (Authentication).
Legacy token endpoint removed — signed-in pages are the only way in; stale cookies redirect to the login page (Authentication).
